faq.q: How much does The Law Office of Matthew Galluzzo charge?
faq.a: The Law Office of Matthew Galluzzo publishes no fee terms on the pages we read, so none is recorded on this profile. An absence here is not a claim that the firm has no fee arrangement, only that it does not state one publicly. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee.

faq.q: Does The Law Office of Matthew Galluzzo offer a free consultation?
faq.a: The Law Office of Matthew Galluzzo does not publish a free consultation on the pages we read. That is not the same as charging for one, and it is worth asking. The intake line is published as open around the clock.

faq.q: Where does The Law Office of Matthew Galluzzo have offices?
faq.a: The Law Office of Matthew Galluzzo publishes one office, in Manhattan. Addresses and the Google listing behind each one are on this profile under Offices.

faq.q: Who are the attorneys at The Law Office of Matthew Galluzzo?
faq.a: The Law Office of Matthew Galluzzo names one attorney on its own site, and each is listed on this profile with the page we read them from. 1 of 1 named attorneys are currently registered and none carries an adverse status.

faq.q: Are the case results The Law Office of Matthew Galluzzo publishes verified?
faq.a: No. The Law Office of Matthew Galluzzo publishes 40 case results with amounts on its own site. We counted them and we did not confirm them: the figures are the firm's. Pillar B scores whether a firm publishes outcomes and discloses them properly, including whether a prior-results disclaimer appears beside them, not whether the amounts are right. Past results do not predict another case.

faq.q: What has Law Firm Listings verified about The Law Office of Matthew Galluzzo?
faq.a: The Law Office of Matthew Galluzzo scores 65 and sits at Verified. Passed: licensure, discipline, entity registration, website and footprint. Every row of the scorecard above names where the value came from and when it was read. Nothing on this profile was supplied by the firm for payment, and no placement here can be bought.
